{{Quote|These people accidentally discovered the ''teleportal'', Keeper, but they're ''nice''... certainly no ''threat'' to the ''great plan''.|The Keeper's creations|<ref name="COM" />}}
The '''Teleportal''' was a device in the [[Keeper's Temple]] that teleported the users from the ruins above ground to the vast cavern complex below.

==Description==
Once activated a teleportal caused everything in range to vanish in a flash of light. The process was not instantaneous, but was rapid. Matter transported through the teleportal would reappear at their destination.

On [[The Keeper's World]] there was a teleportal hidden in the [[Keeper's Temple]]. The hidden teleportal activated by pressing a switch hidden in the reliefs carved in the ruined temple walls, and teleported all those in range to the caverns beneath the surface of the planet where [[The Keeper]] was housed.<ref name="PATR" />

==History==
While cornered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] during the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accidentally activated the teleportal in the Keeper's Temple. This teleported him, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to the caverns below, where they would eventually meet the Keeper.<ref name="PATR" /> The pursuing Stormtroopers and their [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Keeper's World)|commander]] soon discovered the teleportal, and used it to continue their pursuit in the caverns below.<ref name="DYKWYCA">''[[Do You Know What Your Children Are?]]''</ref>
